decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures, then using reanimation spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate to bring them back onto the battlefield for a low cost. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck aims to be proactive and win the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent. The mana base is designed to support the combo with a mix of fetchlands and dual lands.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions using counterspells and removal spells, while also utilizing cards like Dress Down and Flame of Anor to disrupt their strategies. The deck also includes threats like Murktide Regent and Thundertrap Trainer to pressure the opponent. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and helps dig through the deck for key cards. The mana base consists of a mix of dual lands and fetch lands to ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent while gradually establishing a winning position.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the Mystic Forge combo quickly using cards like Grim Monolith and Planar Nexus to generate mana. The key cards in this combo are Manifold Key and The One Ring which allow for infinite mana and card draw. Tezzeret, Cruel Captain and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional control and searching abilities. The goal is to use Mystic Forge to cast multiple spells in a turn and eventually win the game with a powerful board presence or combo finish.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo and control the opponent's game plan. By efficiently combining card selection and graveyard manipulation, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bringing them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. It also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo and control the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent adds versatility and additional threats to the deck, making it a formidable force in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this Doomsday combo deck is to quickly assemble the necessary cards to cast Doomsday and set up a winning pile with Thassa's Oracle. The deck includes cards like Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate mana quickly, along with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for combo pieces. Force of Will, Daze, and Thoughtseize provide protection and disruption against the opponent's game plan. By carefully sequencing spells and manipulating the deck with Doomsday, the goal is to win the game in a single explosive turn.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly put powerful creatures into the graveyard, then bring them back into play using reanimation spells such as Animate Dead and Reanimate. The deck focuses on using cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect your combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes cards like Entomb and Brainstorm to set up the perfect graveyard and find the necessary combo pieces. The deck aims to win the game by overwhelming the opponent with massive creatures while controlling the board with counter spells and disruption.

The main concept of the deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while putting pressure on them with efficient threats. This is achieved through a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize, countermagic such as Force of Will, and removal spells like Fatal Push. The deck also aims to control the board with cards like Daze and Murktide Regent while utilizing card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. By efficiently deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's plays, the deck aims to close out the game quickly and decisively.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with key creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bringing them back into play with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The strategy involves disrupting opponents with counter spells like Force of Will and Daze while also controlling the board with cards like Murktide Regent and Archon of Cruelty. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and further graveyard manipulation. The deck aims to win quickly by overwhelming opponents with powerful creatures coming back from the graveyard.

The main concept of this deck is to efficiently disrupt the opponent's game plan while aggressively applying pressure with cheap and efficient creatures. The deck aims to control the game through hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and countermagic like Force of Will, while deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower to quickly close out the game. The deck also utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push to deal with problematic creatures. The mana base is designed to support the deck's tempo strategy with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands.

This Death & Taxes deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies while maintaining a strong aggro presence. The main idea is to use cards like Thoughtseize and Swords to Plowshares to control the board, while creatures like Thalia and Skyclave Apparition put pressure on the opponent. Aether Vial helps cheat creatures into play, while Stoneforge Mystic searches for powerful equipment like Kaldra Compleat. The deck also utilizes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion to provide additional value and card advantage. The goal is to outpace the opponent and overwhelm them with efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

This control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, removal like Swords to Plowshares, and card advantage engines like Ponder and Brainstorm. The deck also includes Leyline cards to give additional protection and leverage the multicolored nature of the mana base. The win condition is a mix of efficient creatures like Scion of Draco and value-generating cards like Up the Beanstalk and Leyline Binding. The deck aims to control the game until it can establish a dominant board presence and secure the win.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty, then using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for a devastating combo finish. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker to control the game and protect the combo. Additionally, cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Murktide Regent provide card advantage and versatility. The deck aims to exploit the graveyard as a resource and overwhelm opponents with fast, powerful plays.

The main focus of this UWx Control deck is to establish and maintain control over the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck utilizes cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats, while also using card draw spells like Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to maintain a steady flow of resources. Additionally, cards like Back to Basics and Magus of the Moon can disrupt opponents' mana bases, further increasing the control the deck has over the game.

This deck focuses on using powerful artifacts like Chalice of the Void and The One Ring to disrupt opponents while putting pressure with aggressive creatures like Laelia, the Blade Reforged and Magus of the Moon. With fast mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox, as well as efficient removal spells like Sundering Eruption and Fury, the deck aims to control the game and overpower the opponent quickly. Using cards like Karn, the Great Creator to lock opponents out of the game and cards like Relic of Progenitus to disrupt graveyard strategies, the deck aims to disrupt opponents while quickly closing out the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing Mystic Forge in combination with cards like Basalt Monolith, Manifold Key, and Voltaic Key to generate mana and cast artifacts for free. It also includes powerful artifacts like Urza's Saga and Karn, the Great Creator to control the board and search for key pieces. The goal is to assemble a powerful board state quickly and overwhelm the opponent with large threats, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Pithing Needle and Soul-Guide Lantern. The deck is designed to be fast and efficient, aiming to win the game in just a few turns.
